title: SMART: Scalable Multi-agent Real-time Motion Generation via Next-token Prediction

control_signal.value: No user-steerable signal; model conditions on previous motion tokens, other agents' tokens and encoded road tokens. Top-5 token sampling is used to balance realism and diversity.

control_mechanism.value: Decoder-only Transformer with temporal, agent-agent and agent-map attention predicts next motion token; no steering mechanism described.

base_model.value: GPT-style decoder-only Transformer over discrete tokens (k-disks vocabulary): RoadNet road-token encoder and factorized MotionNet decoder, with road-vector next-token prediction task; sizes 1M to 101M parameters.

datasets.value: Waymo Open Motion Dataset (WOMD), NuPlan, and a proprietary dataset; over 1 billion motion tokens collected; zero-shot test trains on NuPlan only and evaluates on WOMD.

metrics.value: WOSAC realism meta metric with kinematic, interactive and map-based components, plus minADE. SMART 7M on 2023 benchmark: realism 0.6587, kinematic 0.4190, interactive 0.8014, map 0.8523, minADE 1.7453.

controllability_evidence.value: not stated in packet; no controllability experiment. Zero-shot score of 0.72 on Sim Agents challenge when trained only on NuPlan is a generalization result.

stated_limitations.value: Simple token vocabulary; scalability tested only up to 100 million parameters due to data size; many hyperparameter ablations remain; transfer to planning and prediction tasks still to be verified.

notes: Not a controllable-generation paper; it is a scalable realistic sim-agents model.
